277587955.description:
Smoking Pipe Lot - 4 Pieces
Mixed Woods, Tobacco Pipes
Vintage
This collection features four distinct tobacco smoking pipes, each showcasing different materials and craftsmanship styles. From classic smooth briar-style finishes to rustic natural bark construction, this lot offers a variety of pieces for collectors or restoration enthusiasts. These vintage pipes reflect mid-20th-century smoking accessories and functional art.
Items Included:
Smooth dark wood pipe with black plastic stem and silver-tone decorative band
Rustic natural bark pipe with T-joint construction and untreated wood stem
Rough-textured matte wood pipe with a tapered black plastic stem
Polished dark wood pipe with two engraved rings on the bowl rim and brown stem
Condition:
Used vintage condition. Bowls show interior charring from previous use. The rustic bark pipe has a visible vertical crack in the bowl rim. Stems show light oxidation and tooth wear. Surface scuffs, finish wear, and scratches are present throughout the lot consistent with age.

Geological Specimen Study Set
8 Natural Mineral Samples in Display Box
8" x 6" x 2"
Numbered Collection
This professional mineral identification kit is an essential resource for geological education and scientific observation. The collection consists of eight distinct natural mineral specimens, including recognizable samples such as crystalline quartz, pink feldspar, and metallic pyrite. Each sample is individually numbered, allowing for systematic classification and study of physical properties such as luster, crystal habit, and cleavage.
Features 8 high-quality natural specimens housed in a 9-compartment white plastic organizer
Housed in a durable red textured storage case with a protective foam-lined interior lid
Provides a hands-on learning experience for students, hobbyists, and amateur geologists
